review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–71) and checked it for repeated proof machinery. The two `dvd_antisymm_of_normalize_eq` branches in `gcd_seq_add` are short mirrored dvd arguments inside a single proof, which the rubric treats as insufficient. I did not search the wider library for similar arguments, because the rubric needs repetition across at least two proofs and the file has none.
